target: existing ONIA VPS via pre-existing SSH identity; exact host verification required
workspace: new root-owned mode-0700 temporary directory; fail if it already exists or resolves elsewhere

steps.command: python3 verifies source-manifest.json and every listed SHA-256; Docker root-directory/preflight and exact derived-tag listing use separate timeout-bounded Docker calls
steps.timeout_scope: each Docker preflight call independently; local fixed-file hash checks and resource reads run before external actions
steps.resource_stop_thresholds: Stop before pull if Docker-root free disk <4 GiB, MemAvailable <1.5 GiB, or 1-minute load average >3.0.
steps.build_resource_cap: No hard CPU or memory cap is claimed for Docker build; these thresholds only gate starting it.

steps.network: MCR for the exact image digest
Docker build uses default egress; the Dockerfile configures official PyPI for four hash-locked binary wheels. Network egress is not separately firewall-allowlisted.

steps.command: docker image inspect reports immutable image ID, configured user pwuser, base digest and requirements-lock label; write one 0600 receipt with authorization/source hashes

after_install_checkpoint: Hold before browser trial. Independent reviewer checks installation receipt and immutable image ID, then reads numeric pwuser UID/GID from the image without starting a container; bind those values, QA receipt hash, image ID, install receipt hash, source manifest hash and a newly generated 32-hex one-use nonce into the private 0700 control directory. A second QA checkpoint must pass before the one smoke invocation.
failure_handling: Any failed/ambiguous pull or build writes needs_reconcile; retain receipt and artifacts, do not retry or fall back.
